items.q: And we always worked beside each other on many things, many gigs.

ctx.x: Cecil Scott. And we always worked beside each other on many things, many gigs. So I knew him. I knew him. So when I got there, well, he was in India. So I played first trumpet part, they had a boy named Hamilton but I think he was from Martinique or Guadeloupe somewhere. But they weren't all Americans (inaudible).

So the first month was rehearsing. I'd rehearse -- voice rehearsal. We were singing, we were singing German songs, in choir, French songs in the choir. And then you had to get your solos together, too, because that band would get out there and just put on a show and be there for an hour singing.
